name: @useyolo/model-subscriptions
description: Official Yolo model provider plugin: gives other plugins a language model on the owner's own subscription, borrowing the sign-in of the Codex or Claude Code already on the media node's machine, or Yolo's own sign-in

summary.en: Lets other plugins use a language model on your own subscription, such as to name your files.
summary.zh: 让其他插件用你自己订阅的语言模型，例如给你的文件起名。

privacy.en: Sends file names and titles to the model you signed in to.
privacy.zh: 把文件名和标题发给你登录的模型。
